items.engineers: Existing operating point ~3,200 gpm at ~120 ft TDH with two pumps (matches Feb 2016 field test); far below 4,960 gpm.
Reaching 4,960 gpm through the existing force main needs ~235 ft TDH and ~102 psi; the main has broken at 90 psi, so pump replacement alone is not recommended.
Replace ~8,500 LF of the 18-inch CI force main with 24-inch DIP and fit 18-inch impellers (max size) -> ~5,000 gpm at ~120 ft with two pumps. Recommended (lowest life-cycle cost ~$3.07M).
leak_phrases: 8,500 LF of Existing Force Main with 24-inch

items.engineers: Parallel 8,500 LF 18-inch DIP force main + 18-inch impellers -> ~5,200 gpm; viable but costlier.
Upsizing impellers 17.25 -> 18 inch shortens the force main replacement by ~700 LF (~$115,000 saving).
leak_phrases: shortens the necessary force main replacement
